The cooktop has four burners, with the left side having a larger, round, black burner and the right side having two smaller burners. The oven has a metal rack inside. The cooker is in a room with a concrete floor and other appliances in the background. A poster with 'HITHE TECHNOLOGIES' is visible on the back of the cooker in photo 0. The cooker is in a state of disrepair, with some scratches and dirt on the surface.
